name: Moror Wendael
keeps: what grows on her side of the wall
does: Signs at one door and no other. If she will not sign, that door does not move.
reason: First clear clinical distinction between smallpox and measles, and an early sceptic of alchemy as transmutation while doing the chemistry anyway.
text: Moror wendael of the salt stair, keeps a door for the 15th tranche, doors 134 to 142. Keeps what grows on her side of the wall. Reads Al-Razi (Rhazes).
